title: Juicy Spicy Ethiopian Beef Gored Gored
description: A spicy and chewy Ethiopian dish featuring white bread mix and a sweet glaze, served on a salt block. This festive dish is perfect for special occasions and is anti-inflammatory friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the white bread mix, berbere spice, and salt.
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the bread mixture.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the beef until browned on all sides.
In a small bowl, whisk together the honey, garlic, and ginger to make the glaze.
Brush the glaze over the cooked beef and place on a preheated salt block.
Bake the beef in the preheated oven for 10 minutes to caramelize the glaze.
Remove the beef from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
